messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: geom_line error
parts:
Hi:

A guess: try adding group = 1 in the aes() paragraph of ggplot() and
see if that helps.

A better solution would be for you to convert week to a Date variable
using a full date and then:
(a) load the scales package;
(b) rerun the ggplot() call and add scale_x_date(labels =
date_format("%b-%d"))

Had you provided data I could have given you a more complete answer,
but at least str() provides a clue.

Dennis
